info.title: RSNA Knee: 97.13% Accuracy at 60% Coverage
info.subtitle: 11 labels across 4,407 studies; synovitis is not included
info.description:
**97.13% accuracy at 60% finding coverage** on the expert-labeled RSNA knee development subset.

This dataset provides continuous scores for **11 findings across all 4,407 RSNA training studies. Synovitis is not included.**

The score was measured on 58 expert-labeled development studies: **372 of 383 accepted findings were correct**, out of 638 evaluated findings. Exact coverage is 60.03%, rounded to 60%. The conditional study-bootstrap 95% accuracy interval is 95.30%–98.69%. This is a familiar development panel used during dataset development.

Included findings: ACL, MCL, Medial Meniscus, Lateral Meniscus, Medial OA, Lateral OA, PF OA, Effusion, Baker's cyst, Contusion, and Fracture.

The release includes continuous labels, confidence scores, the 60% acceptance mask, study metadata, evaluation results, attribution, and reproducibility files. The accuracy-oriented files are accuracy_soft_labels.csv, accuracy_confidence.csv, and accuracy_accepted60.csv.

Source attribution and licence notices are included in the release. Original competition data remain subject to their own terms.
info.userSpecifiedSources: Original study identifiers, reports and finding schema: [RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-knee-abnormality-detection). This versioned research snapshot contains derived continuous labels curated from the training reports and supporting research predictions, organized by StudyInstanceUID. Eleven findings are included; Synovitis is excluded. Evaluation covers 58 expert-labeled development studies. Raw reports, images, patient identifiers and the official answer key are not redistributed. Full source attribution, licences and provenance are retained in source_provenance.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. No regular update schedule is planned.
